category_title: Non-verbal students with ASD who use non-verbal requests for help and enjoy sensory play
scenario_title: 1:1 interaction session using sensory play and music
minimal_context: Trevor and a tutor are in a 1:1 interaction session using a music player to work on communication skills.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our daily music session. Sit down in your chair and we will sing a song.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks over to the music player, picks it up, and pushes it toward the tutor's hands, gesturing for help to turn it on without making eye contact.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We can't turn the music on yet. You need to sit in your chair and look at me first.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops the music player on the table, turns his back to the tutor, and stares at the wall, completely ignoring the instruction.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Trevor, listen to me. Come back here and sit down right now so we can start our activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Vocalizes a loud, sharp protest, pushes the chair away forcefully, and continues to actively ignore the adult by walking to the opposite corner of the room.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our daily music session. Sit down in your chair and we will sing a song.

STUDENT: (Walks over to the music player, picks it up, and pushes it toward the tutor's hands, gesturing for help to turn it on without making eye contact.)

TUTOR: We can't turn the music on yet. You need to sit in your chair and look at me first.

STUDENT: (Drops the music player on the table, turns his back to the tutor, and stares at the wall, completely ignoring the instruction.)

TUTOR: Trevor, listen to me. Come back here and sit down right now so we can start our activity.

STUDENT: (Vocalizes a loud, sharp protest, pushes the chair away forcefully, and continues to actively ignore the adult by walking to the opposite corner of the room.)

task.content: Engaging in an interaction session using rough and tumble play, singing, and music
task.learning_goal: Improve communication skills and increase verbal and nonverbal initiations

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Immediately following the adults' directive communication
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Protests at a rate ranging from 0.42 - 4.6 incidences per minute, and 'ignoring' behaviours
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: did not like demands and expectations placed on them

behavior_patterns.condition: When unable to access a motivating item independently
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: occasionally requests help non-verbally from adult

behavior_patterns.condition: When adults direct the interaction, seek the child's attention more than follow the interest of the child, or give commands
